subject: FEATURES.md §4 dashboard improvement plan
question: Does the plan answer 'which account has crypto and did we download it', 'what is missing and can I queue it now', and 'is the fleet healthy' as the operator asked?

scenarios.scenario: P0-2 is new work because no per-area live/downloaded/missing matrix exists (#16).
scenarios.assumption: OverviewTab has only global counts until P0-2 ships.
scenarios.evidence: src/admin/OverviewTab.jsx:238-251 renders verify.areas as live/exported/missing per area with a clickable 'missing' that queues export(missing); /tmp/v3-demo-store.json account demo.panel@example.com has verify.areas for 8 areas; screenshot 02 shows the same section for example.harvest with the 'Run Verify live' empty state because that account has verify:null.
scenarios.remaining_uncertainty: The existing matrix is manifest-derived, not disk-derived, and only appears after a live verify; whether it disagrees with files on disk is untested (no verify job was run in the demo).

scenarios.scenario: The operator must know where to look because search is per-account; P1-3 must add global search.
scenarios.assumption: No cross-account search endpoint or UI exists.
scenarios.evidence: src/admin/Admin.jsx:336-342 opens LibraryTab as 'All'; LibraryTab.jsx:424 searches 'every note, image (OCR), contact, calendar entry and seed' and passes accountId/type/kind to /api/admin/library; server/admin/library.js queryCatalog filters all areas by q and accountId.
scenarios.remaining_uncertainty: Saved searches and URL deep links are genuinely absent; server-side grouping by area is only for the 'all' type (12/24 item previews).

scenarios.scenario: A mock-worker run can leave a job in state 'failed', as P0-1's acceptance requires.
scenarios.assumption: 'failed' is a job status in the socket process.
scenarios.evidence: server/socket/worker-pool.js writes 'error' (1158, 1221), 'cancelled' (411), 'twofa' (934), 'done'; server/store.js createJob starts at 'queued' (500) and markStaleJobs writes 'unknown' (206). grep -n "failed" on both files has no status hit.
scenarios.remaining_uncertainty: The plan may intend to introduce a 'failed' state in P0-1; it does not say so, and per-file failures (P0-4) already use status='failed' in the SQLite manifest, so the two words would collide.

scenarios.scenario: A restart mid-export recovers in-flight jobs, so P0-3's 'order persists after restart' is only about ordering.
scenarios.assumption: WorkerPool rebuilds the queue from any non-terminal job.
scenarios.evidence: Probe /tmp/council-client/probe-store.mjs: Store() with one 'running' export job logs 'job.status after Store(): unknown | error: node restarted' and 'WorkerPool boot would requeue this job: false'. Server order: store created server/socket/index.js:14, pool created :28; pool restart branch accepts only queued/running (worker-pool.js:144-146) after store.js:206 rewrote running to unknown.
scenarios.remaining_uncertainty: Not exercised through a real socket process and live worker; the probe uses the production Store class only.

scenarios.scenario: Selecting 'Photo' in the gallery shows the same 142 tiles as 'Any type'.
scenarios.assumption: The kind select filters the grid.
scenarios.evidence: src/admin/PhotosTab.jsx:129 dependency array is [account.id, area, query] with kind missing, so selecting a kind never reloads; screenshot 17-photos-kind-photo.png shows 'Photo' selected with '142 of 142' and the same 18 tiles as 03-photos.png. A direct gallery() call with kind=photo returns total 0 and kindCounts {"unclassified":142} (probe /tmp/council-client/probe-gallery.mjs).
scenarios.remaining_uncertainty: After fixing the dependency the filter returns 0 for this export because Scan/vlm-index.json is absent; whether a scanned account ever gets kinds is untested.

scenarios.scenario: Global acceptance criterion 4 is already true: EXPORT_ENABLED=false disables every export control.
scenarios.assumption: The UI and worker enforce one export gate.
scenarios.evidence: worker-pool.js:556 exempts mode 'urls' from the gate; OverviewTab.jsx:210-222 leaves 'Photo URLs (no download)' and the Download URLs JSON anchor active when exportEnabled=false; only Export missing / Redownload use the flag.
scenarios.remaining_uncertainty: Whether 'urls' is considered an export control by the plan; it writes Photos/urls.json but downloads no media.

map_validation.checked: map.md items 2, 3, 4 and the restart BUG against store.js, worker-pool.js, server/socket/index.js, python/worker/verify.py.
map_validation.result: consistent with source; the restart bug is real and reproducible with the probe. One correction: manifest rows for example.harvest are 113 distinct assets (104 photos + 9 hidden), which equals unique disk asset ids, while Photos contains 142 files after live-photo proxies and 9 duplicated Hidden stills.
